faultInjection.reason: the natural run produced no failed, abstained or rejected decision

hypotheses.statement: Document retrieval changes the decisions and exposures of the matched agent relative to market-only inputs.
Graph-assisted retrieval delivers additional, provenance-backed passages that change at least one decision.
A lead with two bounded specialists changes decisions relative to the single graph agent under the same budget.

limitations: Synthetic-curve mode: SYN-USD-NOTE-* instruments are hypothetical; marks and fills are curve-model observations plus a declared half-spread, not market quotes. The run shows nothing about observed-security relative value or achievable execution.
Same curve for marks and fills: any rich/cheap signal is mechanically neutral.

Retrospective information policy: document availability is reconstructed (publication time + 120 minutes) and curve availability is 18:00 New York; this is a historical replay, not a forward paper-trading test.

Pretrained-model hindsight: not applicable to reference-heuristic-v1 (a rule-based model with no pretrained knowledge), but it applies to any hosted LLM run on this window; such runs must be labelled retrospective and repeated forward.
AI strategies ran on reference-heuristic-v1, a deterministic rule-based policy model, not a hosted LLM; the results say nothing about LLM decision quality.
Stochastic repetitions are not applicable to the deterministic reference model; hosted models need at least three repetitions when affordable (spec 16.2).

Short window (61 sessions, 60 daily returns): no statistical significance; paired block-bootstrap intervals are descriptive only; Sharpe ratios are unavailable because no risk-free series is declared.
Exposures differ: equal risk limits did not produce equal duration/DV01; compare the exposure section before reading return differences.
Cash earns zero (zero_cash_interest_v1); excess returns are not interpreted.
Half-spread assumptions (0.00/0.02/0.05 per 100 face) are illustrative, not measured Treasury transaction costs.
Evidence pages are 2026 web versions of the FOMC releases (flag current_web_version_not_archived_original), not archived originals.
marketDataset: usd-treasury-par-2023-2024 (U.S. Treasury daily par yield curves)

model.disclosure: reference-heuristic-v1 is a deterministic rule-based policy model used for offline demos and tests. It is not a hosted LLM and its outputs are not model inferences.

monetaryCeiling: not applicable: provider reference uses the zero-cost price schedule; priced hosted runs require a versioned price schedule and maxCostUsd
purpose: Demonstration bundle for milestone M7 and the spec 17.6 demo script. Not a held-out evaluation and not evidence of strategy skill.
redistribution: Bundle contains only synthetic instruments, U.S. Treasury par curve values and Federal Reserve FOMC text excerpts (U.S. government works, public domain) plus outputs of the reference model.

repetitions.stochasticRepetitions: not applicable: reference-heuristic-v1 is deterministic (identical output for identical input); hosted models need >= 3 repetitions

responseModes.capture: fresh_inference of reference-heuristic-v1 through a recording provider
responseModes.verification: recorded_replay with replay_source=recorded_responses and every provider disabled; plus recorded_replay with replay_source=stored_results
